name: docs-toolkit
description: Schema-driven documentation validation, creation, and migration. Enforces document structure via JSON schemas and surfaces code-reference drift in changed docs as a non-blocking advisory at the turn boundary (hard enforcement belongs at commit/CI, where the change is attributable); age-based staleness is advisory, and terminal-status docs are exempt from drift checks. Supports ADRs, RFCs, specs, runbooks, tasks, learnings, explanations, and references.
